verification.pascal_suite_result: Clean full runner passed on 2026-11-25: 84/84 direct Turbo Pascal 5.5 sessions and 44/44 configured Pascal-to-production comparison invocations. The compiled-Pascal BoardClose/WorldSave output matched shared LibZoo zoo_board_close plus zoo_io_world_write byte-for-byte across the complete 25,928-byte .ZZT (SHA-256 5ca053d06dbc8673c93c02e65c97bdf4692995bd1642d6341cc1b8ed24f6f9fa); the 289-byte Pascal board record separately matched shared .BRD import/export. Runtime compatibility passed. The integrated prototype matched 12 checkpoints and 41,690 state fields, two sound events / 20 fields, nine cell writes / 36 fields, and 565 deterministic bytes in a generated 961-byte fresh-world SAV. Both engines then loaded the exact Pascal-generated SAV (WorldLoad=true; zoo_world_load=0) and generated a round-trip SAV with all 949 preserved non-pointer bytes matching; only 12 process-specific stat pointer positions were classified. The integrated probe is compiled and run in separate DOSBox-X sessions to control inherited allocator history. The short-header BoardOpen attempt remains excluded because it has no stable oracle result; the BRDXFER modal-boundary intervention is documented separately.

known_discrepancies: Short-payload .BRD editor import directly reaches BoardCreate and matches seven selected production board/player fields. Earlier short-header captures came from an invalid nine-character DOS filename and are discarded. Corrected SHORTHD attempts stall or fail with Turbo Pascal runtime error 203 at the freed-buffer BoardOpen; expected control flow and the production safe-reopen model are source-derived, not direct differentials.
Player element metadata differs: Pascal mutates ElementDefs[4].Character while LibZoo uses a draw callback. Resulting virtual-cell behavior across all animation cases remains to be proven.
Editor flood-fill and .HI table semantics are now shared and directly compared; placement/paste/stat mutation side effects and other Editor.PAS state changes remain outside the platform-neutral API.

The integrated prototype matches 41,690 variable-size state fields across 12 checkpoints, including pause-to-play, post-save, and post-reload transitions; two sound events / 20 fields and nine ordered playfield writes / 36 fields also match. One generated 961-byte SAV matches at all 565 stable positions; 396 fresh-world undefined/pointer positions are classified (327 differ, 69 happen to match). Both sides load the exact Pascal-generated SAV (WorldLoad=true; zoo_world_load=0), then the round-trip save matches all 949 preserved non-pointer bytes while classifying the 12 process-specific stat pointer positions. Pascal WorldSave failure-path outcomes, other scenarios, and the ten required fixtures remain open.
